6: The purpose of this report is to document the results of a study conducted in search of the

10: The objective of this study was to find a wire with a consistent, linear resistance versus
11: temperature characteristic and with a “significant” slope.
13: Scope:
14: This study was conducted in the Phase A Laboratory (Bldg 77, Room 154A) on
15: commercially available wire. The ignitor manufacturing technique and the pyrolization

24: wire types were subjected to additional tests to examine the effects of the previous
25: thermal cycle(s).
27: The test fixture held approximately thirty-four inches (0.86 meters) of wire.
